title: Collection input field
description: Several values of one kind, an item each, in their order: the field repeated (`entry`, any single field of the norm — a text, a number, a code —) once per value (`items`), one more added from `template`, any taken off, moved up and down. Its value is the list, not a text: `value` stays unset. Sent as a list, each item under its index as its entry would be sent alone — `form[field][0]`, `form[field][1]` —, nothing under the field's name when the list is empty, so the values it held are taken off.

entry.description: The field each item is, of any kind but a collection: its kind and what the kind takes. Its `name` and `label` stand for every item; its own value is not read.

items.description: Each item's value, as its entry holds one: a text, a yes or no, a list.

template.description: What an item added starts from: an example to fill in. Unset, the entry's empty value.
